welcome.title: Welcome to Husonym
welcome.text: Husonym makes it easy to anonymize sensitive data, generate synthetic data and sync data across environments. Click Next to learn how Husonym works.

connect.title: Connect
connect.text: Create Connections to your upstream and downstream data sources. Husonym supports a variety of databases and types of object storage.

configure.title: Configure
configure.text: Configure your Schema, Transformers and Subsetting rules in order to anonymize and generate data to sync to lower level environments.

sync.title: Sync
sync.text: Run your job on a set schedule or run it ad-hoc whenever you'd like. Now that you have an idea of Husonym works, click Next to create a Job.

router.title: Select a Job type
router.text: Select the type of job that you would like to create.
router.dataSyncDescription: Sync and anonymize data between a source and destination.
router.dataGenDescription: Generate synthetic data from using Husonym Transformers.
router.aiDataGenDescription: Generate synthetic data from scratch with AI.
